verdict.rationale: Tasks are defined via natural-language queries and job types, and chat sessions let a researcher continue interacting with an agent across turns (implying some steering while it runs), but there is no documented parameter for depth, effort level, iteration budget, or scope before/during a run. Missing for 10: explicit depth/effort/scope controls (e.g., max steps, compute budget, verbosity level), and evidence of mid-run steering beyond conversational chat turns.
